663: 	cooldown = 10,

669: 	getConfuseEfficency = function(self, t) return math.min(50, self:getTalentLevelRaw(t) * 10) end,
670: 	action = function(self, t)
671: 		local tg = {type="hit", range=self:getTalentRange(t)}
672: 		local tx, ty, target = self:getTarget(tg)
673: 		if not tx or not ty then return nil end
674: 		if tx then
675: 			local _ _, tx, ty = self:canProject(tg, tx, ty)
676: 			if tx then
677: 				target = game.level.map(tx, ty, Map.ACTOR)
678: 				if not target then return nil end
679: 			end
680: 		end
681: 
682: 		-- Check hit
683: 		if target:canBe("teleport") and self:checkHit(getParadoxSpellpower(self, t), target:combatSpellResist() + (target:attr("continuum_destabilization") or 0)) then
684: 			-- Grab the caster's location
685: 			local px, py = self.x, self.y
686: 
687: 			-- Remove the target so the destination tile is empty
688: 			game.level.map:remove(target.x, target.y, Map.ACTOR)
689: 
690: 			-- Try to teleport to the target's old location
691: 			if self:teleportRandom(tx, ty, 0) then
692: 				-- Put the target back in the caster's old location
693: 				game.level.map(px, py, Map.ACTOR, target)

695:

697: 				self:project(tg, target.x, target.y, DamageType.CONFUSION, { dur = t.getConfuseDuration(self, t), dam = t.getConfuseEfficency(self, t), apply_power=getParadoxSpellpower(self, t)})

700: 				game.level.map:particleEmitter(target.x, target.y, 1, "temporal_teleport")
701: 				game.level.map:particleEmitter(self.x, self.y, 1, "temporal_teleport")
702: 			else

704: 				game.level.map(target.x, target.y, Map.ACTOR, target)
705: 				game.logSeen(self, "The spell fizzles!")
706: 			end
707: 		else

709: 		end
710: 
711: 		game:playSoundNear(self, "talents/teleport")
712: 		return true
713: 	end,

85: Weisman]]}
